summary: File-based capacity settings, identical on all control nodes: AWX_CONTROL_NODE_TASK_IMPACT sets the cost of controlling a job, and SYSTEM_TASK_FORKS_CPU and SYSTEM_TASK_FORKS_MEM set the estimated cost of a fork (default 0.25 CPU and 100 MB).
questions: How do I limit how many jobs a control node runs?
How much CPU and memory does one fork use by default?
